items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You were saying something about a fellow named Dee Dee just on the tape. >> [INTERVIEWEE] What's his name? Dee Dee Taylor. [INTERVIEWER] What did Dee Dee do? [INTERVIEWEE] He was saying drums. Bass drums.

ctx.x: The tape ran off on the first reel. This is the second reel we're doing now of you and Jim Robinson. You were saying something about a fellow named Dee Dee just on the tape.
What's his name? Dee Dee Taylor.
